patrocinadores.heroTitle: THE BIGGEST DRIFT EXPERIENCE IN <green>LATIN AMERICA</green>
patrocinadores.heroText: Ultimate Drift is the biggest drift championship in Latin America, a show that brings together speed, excitement and a passionate crowd. Thousands of fans follow every round in person and online, connecting brands with a loyal and engaged audience.
patrocinadores.whyText: Sponsoring Ultimate Drift means associating your brand with performance, innovation and excitement. More than an event, it is entertainment that grows every year, with TV presence, strong social media impact and growing reach across Latin America and other countries.
patrocinadores.broadcastText: Ultimate Drift is broadcast on several free-to-air and cable TV channels, digital platforms and more, reaching over 200 million users in Brazil, the USA and Europe, including: Samsung TV, Pluto, TCL, LG, YouTube, Twitch and others.
patrocinadores.partnershipIntro: We offer different formats to fit your brand's profile and strategy
patrocinadores.annualText: Your brand throughout the whole season, with national exposure at every round, on broadcast channels and official materials.
patrocinadores.annual2: Placements in official digital content and social media
patrocinadores.stageText: Your brand throughout the round, with national exposure, broadcast channels and official materials.
patrocinadores.stage1: Branding across all of the round's local communication
patrocinadores.stage3: Presence at the track, activations and food court
patrocinadores.impactText: Ultimate Drift boosts local economies, tourism and commerce. Each event creates hundreds of jobs, draws thousands of people and turns cities into true hubs of excitement. Your brand doesn't just sponsor, it takes part in a growing cultural and economic movement.
patrocinadores.contactText: We want to build unique experiences with brands that believe in innovation, excitement and purpose. Talk to us and find out how your brand can accelerate alongside the fastest-growing audience in Brazilian motorsport.
patrocinadores.contactClosing: Become an Ultimate Drift sponsor and be part of history.
